messages.subject: batch - possible bug?
parts:
Hi,
if I run the batch function with like batch(n=5, timeout=Inf) then it will make batches of 1 instead of 5. However if I rzun the batch with batch(n=5, timeout=10000) , a large number for timeout instead of Inf, then the batches will be of size 5. Might this be a bug?

Kind regards
Sandor
